en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a church complex on a small hill with staircases and a terraced garden in the foreground. A large residential-looking building with a steep tiled roof stands to the left, while a stone church with pointed roofs and a tall spire rises behind trees on the right. The lower edge bears printed red captions naming the place, and there is a red handwritten number in the top-right margin.
